Package org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.container.component

Class GuiCraftingPlanGraph

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.client.gui.components.AbstractWidget
org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.container.component.GuiCraftingPlanGraph
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.client.gui.components.events.GuiEventListener, net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Renderable, net.minecraft.client.gui.components.TabOrderedElement, net.minecraft.client.gui.layouts.LayoutElement, net.minecraft.client.gui.narration.NarratableEntry, net.minecraft.client.gui.narration.NarrationSupplier, net.neoforged.neoforge.client.extensions.IAbstractWidgetExtension, IGuiCraftingPlanView
public class GuiCraftingPlanGraph extends net.minecraft.client.gui.components.AbstractWidget implements IGuiCraftingPlanView
A gui component for visualizing a crafting plan as a pannable and zoomable graph, with the requested output on the left and its ingredients to the right. The using gui must call the methods listed in IGuiCraftingPlanView.

  • Constructor Details

    • GuiCraftingPlanGraph

      public GuiCraftingPlanGraph(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen parentGui, ITerminalCraftingPlan<?> craftingPlan, int guiLeft, int guiTop, int x, int y, int viewWidth, int viewHeight, boolean live, @Nullable GuiCraftingPlanGraph previous)
      Parameters:
      parentGui - The gui this is drawn in.
      craftingPlan - The plan to visualize.
      guiLeft - The gui X position.
      guiTop - The gui Y position.
      x - The viewport X position, relative to the gui.
      y - The viewport Y position, relative to the gui.
      viewWidth - The viewport width.
      viewHeight - The viewport height.
      live - If this shows a running job, which changes over time. It then shows a status legend instead of the controls hint, and initially leaves room for the plan to grow.
      previous - The graph that showed an earlier version of this plan, to continue from.

  • Method Details

    • restoreOutputs

      protected static void restoreOutputs(List<GuiCraftingPlan.Element> elements, it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.ints.Int2ObjectMap<List<List<org.cyclops.commoncapabilities.api.ingredient.IPrototypedIngredient<?,?>>>> knownOutputs)
      Remember the outputs of crafting jobs, and show the last known outputs of jobs that currently have none. The outputs of a running job only include what remains to be crafted, so they are empty once it is done.
      Parameters:
      elements - The elements of the plan.
      knownOutputs - The last known outputs per element id, which will be updated.

    • restoreCompletedJobs

      public static void restoreCompletedJobs(List<GuiCraftingPlan.Element> previousElements, List<GuiCraftingPlan.Element> elements)
      Crafting jobs are removed from a running plan once they are done. Keep showing them as completed in the place where they were, so that progress stays visible and the layout does not change by itself.
      Parameters:
      previousElements - The elements of the previous version of the plan.
      elements - The elements of the plan, to which completed jobs will be added.

    • getFlowDashes

      public static List<int[]> getFlowDashes(int from, int to, int offset, int period, int length)
      Determine the dashes of a dashed line, aligned to absolute positions so that adjacent lines move in step.
      Parameters:
      from - The start of the line, inclusive.
      to - The end of the line, exclusive.
      offset - The animation offset, where increasing it moves the dashes towards the start.
      period - The distance between the starts of two dashes.
      length - The dash length.
      Returns:
      Pairs of the start (inclusive) and end (exclusive) of each dash, clipped to the line.
